what: Stage 2B-kappa: afferent synaptic efficacy kappa (amendment A8)

criteria.active: rate > 1.0 Hz at any 1 ms sample after 250 ms
criteria.terciles: per leg, MNs sorted by wTable size, numpy.array_split into 3 by rank
criteria.pass: C1 and C2 together in >= 95% of calibration replicates, in every cell
criteria.kappa_star: largest grid kappa passing in all 4 cells
criteria.effective: per cell: >= 50% of replicates have >= 1 active smallest-tercile MN

setup.kappa_applies_to: outgoing synapses (post x pre columns) of the 31 included afferents
setup.stimulus: transduction of the walking clip's angles and velocities (1 s, differentiated, tiled to 2 s), both front legs; campaniform force from the A3 replay, tiled
setup.integrator: flybrain/rate_stepper.py RK4, h = 0.1 ms, afferent input held per step
